status: G0/G1 input only; no product/runtime acceptance

hashRules.normalizedLfSha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 after CRLF-to-LF only; lone CR unchanged
hashRules.canonical: JSON.stringify recursively sorts object keys with JavaScript string < comparator; arrays preserve order
hashRules.nonTargetOperations: [{method,path,operation}], excludes the two operationIds; sorted by method + single ASCII space + path using JavaScript string < comparator; canonicalized then SHA256
